## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      8 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 28 mar 2026 - 18 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _infrequent-yoyo_, 28 mar 2026, 1/5: "I have used this app for years, although it is pretty good and collates all sorts of data into one place and is especially powerful for those interested in Powerlifting etc., the app has always been buggy, workouts not synchronising, workouts misalignment with iPhone and Apple Watch, workouts disappearing. These bugs have remained the same over more than 5 years of use and the developers haven’t bothered to fix them. It’s actually gotten worse where the app deletes workouts and won’t even synchronise between Watch and iPhone. I’ve had enough and won’t be renewing my subscription. Don’t waste your money if you hope to use an Apple Watch with this."
            2. _@fgrdt567_, 3 jul 2026, 2/5: "Today is my first day working with this app. I’m entering custom exercises to build my first routine. The app has frozen several times and needed to be restarted."
            3. _PezzaP99_, 17 jul 2026, 3/5: "Apple Watch app is very glitchy and isn’t very streamlined to use. I recommend Hevy for Apple Watch users, it works far better. If you’re just using a phone then this app will be fine."
<!--/ir-theme-->
